title.narrative: Increased capacity of national stakeholders to improve access to lifelong learning and inclusive skills development and support labour market transitions particularily for vulnerable groups

description.narrative: CPO EGY 102 promotes skills development and lifelong learning in Egypt, contributing to ILO Outcome 3. It addresses challenges such as youth unemployment, skills mismatches, and the inclusion of vulnerable groups, including women, disabled individuals, and migrants. Supported by international partners, the CPO advances projects like Employment for Youth in Egypt (EYE) and Skills for Prosperity. Key achievements include promoting digital and green skills, quality apprenticeships, and inclusive policies aligned with Egypt’s Vision 2030. These efforts enhance public-private collaboration and help prepare the workforce for future labor market demands.
